title: Stabilize repo assistant GitHub PR inspection validation
specification:
# PRD: Stabilize repo assistant GitHub PR inspection validation

Priority: high

## Problem
Repo assistant GitHub PR inspection is currently unavailable in `autonomy-v2` with `validation-failed`, so the manager cannot read live PR comments or review threads. The current implementation depends on validation against a configured PR, defaults this repo to PR `#27`, and prior review findings indicate the validation path is brittle and too coupled to normal status refreshes.

## Goal
Make GitHub PR inspection reliably available when runtime auth is valid, while surfacing precise failure reasons when it is not and avoiding live validation work on ordinary status refreshes.

## Requirements
- Support an explicit validation PR override for the repo and make the effective validation PR visible in status/UI.
- Classify failures clearly as missing token, invalid token, unauthorized repo/PR access, repo unavailable, or validation unconfigured.
- Do not perform blocking live GitHub validation on ordinary repeated status snapshot refreshes; use cached or startup/session-scoped validation state instead.
- Keep GitHub network scope limited to the required `api.github.com` PR inspection reads.
- Ensure repo assistant prompt/status context remains secret-safe and never exposes raw token values.
- Add focused tests for valid startup/session enablement and for missing-token, invalid-token, unauthorized-token, and stale validation PR cases.

## Acceptance Criteria
- When runtime auth is valid and the configured validation PR is readable, repo assistant GitHub inspection reports `available: true` and can read PR metadata/comments/threads.
- When auth is invalid or unauthorized, status/UI reports the specific failure reason without exposing secrets.
- Repeated status refreshes do not trigger live GitHub validation calls unless a session/startup validation is explicitly happening.
- The effective validation PR number is visible in repo status so operators can detect stale configuration quickly.
- Focused unit coverage exists for validation success, cached status behavior, and each major failure mode.

## Verification
- Run `npm run typecheck`.
- Run `tests/unit/control-plane-github.test.ts`.
- Run `tests/unit/control-plane-status.test.ts`.
- Run `tests/unit/control-plane-chat.test.ts` if prompt/status context changes.
- Confirm repo status shows either `GitHub access ready` or a precise failure classification with the effective validation PR number.
